_comment: Pacing for this account (chosen by the workflow's 'account' input). Entries whose key starts with '_' are notes and are ignored.

"1", "2", ...: minimum seconds from a question's arrival to its answer click. AI thinking time counts towards it. "default" applies to any question without its own key (and to quizzes with more than 5 questions).
"max_quiz_seconds": ceiling on total time since this account's challenge open time (challenge_open_time.json). Each pacing wait is shortened so it never pushes the total past this value.
Tip: keep the first ~3 questions quick; later, harder questions can take longer. Values are seconds (decimals allowed). Keep valid JSON: double quotes, no trailing commas.
